assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG PIXEL ART close-up review board for three old household doorway traces, not a playable room. Three equal separated close-up panels on plain warm grey, no labels. In EACH panel show only a small fixed original wooden door-jamb edge adjoining worn stone, viewed from the PUBLIC OUTSIDE; no room beyond, no detached cut-out evidence pieces. LEFT: one clear old crescent-shaped polished rub on the lower-middle door jamb, beside a humble dark iron cooking pot whose worn side loop handle is near but NOT touching that rub. CENTER: old shallow irregular hand-worn groove in fixed wooden jamb, no symbols or names. RIGHT: a different old low patch of worn wood with a small surviving rough original edge, no symbols or names. All wear must look old, finite and physically part of the existing jamb, never newly carved testimony. These are three distinct local traces, NOT three newly available dwellings, not proof of ownership or identity. Keep exact wear forms a visual proposal; only left pot-handle correspondence is sourced specificity. Chunky hard square pixel clusters, restrained muted brown wood grey stone iron palette, dark selective outlines, simple three-tone volumes; not smooth painting. No humans, children, text, letters, numbers, runes, house crests, keys, documents, beds, fresh construction, collapsing-wall exploration, glowing forensic overlays or UI. Close crop makes wear read clearly without creating additional private interiors. Preserve ambiguity: observation supports remembered residence only and never establishes present property rights.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original grounded medieval RPG low-resolution PIXEL ART prop review. One old humble willow basket repair SAMPLE, no finished student product or people. Plain opaque warm grey background. Close three-quarter view: ONE small old oval basket with empty interior and one clearly visible broken horizontal weaving strip near its front; two old broken ends visible with gap. Immediately BESIDE it rests ONE small independent flat practice weave fragment on low wooden support: only six vertical ribs, horizontal strips with one clearly visible overlapped replacement SPLICE in the middle, and a partly completed bound top RIM with short unfinished ends at far right. This is static prepared teaching material, NOT before-after events and not proof any student has learned. Basket and fragment share muted worn wicker material, replacement short strip a slightly lighter tan, difference legible but not glowing. A single plain short wooden bodkin lies below, no knife, no workshop, no warehouse, no grain bags or debt papers. Thick hard square pixel clusters, selective dark outlines, simple restrained three-tone shading; no smooth painting, blur, gradients, high gloss. No text, labels, arrows, UI, person, extra finished baskets, wages or certificates. Exact weaving construction remains an illustrative proposal, not certified load-bearing technique. Keep broken splint ends, overlap practice sample and unfinished rim close enough to inspect.

assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit attached pixel-art basket repair review. Keep LEFT old basket and its broken horizontal strip exactly broken, keep basket shape, wicker materials, plain grey background, wooden bodkin, support and RIGHT fragment upright stakes and unfinished top-rim ends. TARGET ONE CHANGE ONLY: on RIGHT FLAT PRACTICE FRAGMENT, the middle horizontal strip currently has a broken gap. Replace that gap with TWO clearly OVERLAPPING thin woven strips: one darker old strip runs from left past center, one slightly lighter short repair strip overlaps it for a visible long horizontal distance and continues right, its flat end visible. The joined overlap is continuous across former gap, tucked beneath neighboring vertical stakes at both ends; NO central hole or exposed snapped tips on right sample. Do not tie it with cloth or wire. Left basket remains broken for independent source comparison. No hands, text, arrows, extra baskets or finished product. Keep hard pixel clusters, muted colors and framing. This is a static teaching-sample proposal, no claim of completed instruction or load-bearing validation.
